Elsewhere among the Seniors there were steady runs from Owain Lewes, Mike Webb and Mike Lake (running for Alton), but Belgrave were unable to field a scoring six and a half fit Tony Stone turned out as fifth scorer.

Mike Webb was followed by a very strong looking Adam Jones in the early sixties, but came an ashen Junior Galley and miserable looking Mark Anderson both no doubt thinking of the track but both hanging on well to bring all our scorers inside the top hundred for the first time this season.

Charlie Dickinson found the jarring conditions tough for 45 year-old bones but nevertheless had the beating of Alex Luce; Steve Hewes was out for the first time but not eligible to score, so it was left to Mikes Webb and Nouch to close in our team in the 80's.

Last minute recruit for a long stage Mike Webb enjoyed his Essex outing, giving way to Old Gaytonians and finally a Friday night recruit Nick Kello celebrated his birthday (and the Team Manager's) by holding steady in 8th.
